turns.speaker: Michael
turns.text: Alright, thanks everyone for making time — Sarah's joining us today too, so let's do a quick status recap before we dive into anything else.

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: Sure — overall we're in decent shape. Most of the sprint's done, PR's up for review, just waiting on James to take a look.

turns.speaker: James
turns.text: Yeah, I saw it this morning, there's actually a small merge conflict on the checkout branch, but that should be quick to resolve.

turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.text: Sorry, before we go further — can I just clarify something about the referral requirement? I wasn't totally sure what got decided last time.

turns.speaker: Michael
turns.text: Of course, go ahead.

turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.text: So, does the discount apply per order, or per customer across their whole account?

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: Hmm, that's actually still a bit open — I don't think that's something we can commit to without confirming the exact rule with you first.

turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.text: Okay, got it, let's figure that out after this call then.

turns.speaker: Michael
turns.text: Sounds good. Going back to the sprint — James, anything blocking besides the merge conflict?

turns.speaker: James
turns.text: Actually, yeah — QA flagged a new issue on staging just this morning, something with the checkout totals looking off under specific discount combinations.

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: Wait, really? I hadn't heard about that one yet.

turns.speaker: James
turns.text: Yeah, it just came in — I mean, it might be related to the referral logic we're literally just talking about, honestly.

turns.speaker: Michael
turns.text: Okay, that's — [pause] let me think about that for a second. So we've got an open requirement question AND a possibly related bug at the same time?

turns.speaker: James
turns.text: Could be a coincidence, could not be — I don't want to guess without looking at it properly first.

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: Agreed, let's not jump to conclusions — I can pair with James on it right after this.

turns.speaker: Michael
turns.text: Alright. So, at the end of the day, the real question is — does this affect our production deploy timing?

turns.speaker: James
turns.text: Honestly, I'd say hold off until we've confirmed it's not connected to the discount issue, just to be safe.

turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.text: That makes sense to me — I'd rather wait a day than risk something going wrong with pricing.

turns.speaker: Michael
turns.text: Agreed. So, tentatively, deploy's paused pending that investigation.

turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.text: Okay — actually, sorry, random question, but is this something that would affect a possible mobile app version down the line, if we ever built one?

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: Oh — huh, honestly, I hadn't thought about that. It's not something we've looked into at all yet.

turns.speaker: Michael
turns.text: Yeah, that'd be a bigger conversation for another time, but good to keep in mind for the roadmap.

turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.text: Fair enough, just curious. Okay, so let's agree on next steps before we wrap up?

turns.speaker: Michael
turns.text: Sure — David and James pair on the bug and the merge conflict this afternoon, we confirm the referral rule with Sarah separately, and deploy stays on hold until we've got clarity.

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: Works for me, I'll update everyone once we know more.

turns.speaker: James
turns.text: Same here, should have something concrete by end of day.

turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.text: Perfect, thanks everyone — this was a lot, but I feel like we're actually in good shape.

turns.speaker: Michael
turns.text: Agreed, thanks all — let's regroup tomorrow if anything changes before then.
